note: GFP recreation area 4 mi east of Pierre off SD-34, on Hipple Lake, a backwater of Lake Sharpe (Missouri River). Main Campground (1E-70E, with 4 camping cabins) and East Campground (71E-90E) sit about 1 km apart on the north shore; front-row sites 12E, 13E, 16E, 18E, 28E, 30E, 32E, 72E and 74E are on open grass above the sandy shore. The island nature area has 8 mi of hiking trails; swim and dog beaches, boat ramps. --Claude
